The '''Dark Warriors' Fortress''' is a castle in level 14 to 16 [[Multi-combat area|multi-combat]] [[Wilderness]], north of [[Ice Mountain]]. It is populated with level 8 and 145 [[dark warrior]]s in members worlds, but only level 8 [[dark warrior]]s in non-members worlds. Caution should be used as these warriors can overwhelm lower level players who don't use [[Protect from Melee]].

==Transportation==
* [[Burning amulet]] teleport to the [[Bandit Camp (Wilderness)|Bandit Camp]] and run south-west to the entrance
* [[Dareeyak Teleport]] and run south-east.
* Run west from [[Ferox Enclave]].

==Features==
==={{FloorNumber|uk=0|caps=y|nohelp=y}}===
This floor has several rooms, and is crowded with [[dark warriors]]. The northernmost room contains spawns of 5 [[Earth rune|earth]], [[Water rune|water]], [[Air rune|air]], and [[Fire rune|fire]] runes. The room directly west of this contains 5 [[Chaos rune|chaos]], [[Mind rune|mind]], and [[Body rune|body]] runes. In the centre of this floor is a courtyard containing, amongst other things, a crate which players are sometimes led to when completing hard [[Treasure Trail]]s.

==={{FloorNumber|uk=1|caps=y|nohelp=y}}===
This floor is the top level of the castle walls. It contains only level 8 [[dark warriors]], making this a viable option for lower levelled accounts doing [[Wilderness Slayer]].

Players looking to collect rune spawns on the ground floor can climb up the ladder in the south-western room and climb down the broken ladder in the north-western room in order to save a little bit of time coming in, since there is a wall blocking access to the [[chaos rune]]s from the entrance that would otherwise require walking all the way around the castle. The broken ladder does not allow access from the chaos rune spawn room to the upper floor. It is only a one way ladder and may only be climbed from above.

==={{FloorNumber|uk=2|caps=y|nohelp=y}}===
This floor is the inside of the towers. There is nothing of interest in any of the towers.

==={{FloorNumber|uk=3|caps=y|nohelp=y}}===
A spectacular, if grim, view from the spires of the castle. Nothing of interest is found up here.

==Trivia==
*The chaos rune spawn is considerably slower than the other runes' spawns.
*Even though this is the Dark Warriors' Fortress, there appear to be [[Saradomin]] shields mounted on the walls. However, there are swords piercing the shields, meaning that they are likely a statement against Saradomin.
*On the second floor, there is a banner similar to the one in the [[Wizards' Tower]].
